task.description:
WF-03 Step 00.5 (ISSUE-FIXER registry lookup + ISS file creation) for GH-760.

GitHub issue: https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/760
Title: iss205/iss203/iss106/env01/sch02 test binaries fail non-deterministically under -j4 due to public-schema table write conflicts

This issue was already filed on GitHub as GH-760 (filed by DOC-UPDATER during WF03-GH752-20260812 Step 07). ISS-0692.json contains a 'pre_existing_issues_revealed[1]' entry referencing it. A dedicated ISS file does NOT yet exist in docs/issues/.

Tasks:
1. Check docs/issues/issue_index.json and docs/issues/ for any existing ISS file for GH-760. If none, assign the next available ISS ID (highest existing is ISS-0695, so this should be ISS-0696).
2. Create docs/issues/ISS-0696.json with:
   - id: ISS-0696
   - github_issue: https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/760
   - severity: BLOCKER (5-run acceptance gate cannot reach 5/5 clean under -j4; any parallel integration run will be blocked)
   - status: OPEN
   - title: (from GH-760 title)
   - scope: tests/integration/ (5 test binaries: iss205_test, iss203_test, iss106_test, env01_test, sch02_test)
   - discovered_by: TEST-RUNNER
   - discovered_during: WF03-GH752-20260812 five-run acceptance gate
   - description: (from GH-760 description)
   - created_at: current UTC timestamp
3. Update docs/issues/issue_index.json to add ISS-0696 entry.
4. Comment on GH-760 via 'gh issue comment 760 --body "WF03-GH760-20260813 started. ISS-0696 created. Branch: feature/WF03-GH760-20260813. Root cause diagnosis proceeding at Step 01."'

Return PASS when ISS-0696.json created, issue_index.json updated, and GH-760 commented.
acceptance_criteria: docs/issues/ISS-0696.json created with all required fields (id, github_issue, severity=BLOCKER, status=OPEN, title, scope, description, created_at)
docs/issues/issue_index.json updated to include ISS-0696 entry
GH-760 has a comment referencing WF03-GH760-20260813 and ISS-0696

result.summary: ISS-0696 created (docs/issues/ISS-0696.json) for GH-760 (public-schema table write conflicts under -j4). issue_index.json updated with ISS-0696 entry. GH-760 commented via gh CLI (https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/760#issuecomment-5277527775).
